"Remote" is an experimental feature and has not been fully validated.

· Availability not guaranteed: pairing may fail, the link may drop, or it may become unresponsive.
· Data safety not guaranteed: the channel is unencrypted; when you agree to lend a disk, this machine takes the entire physical disk offline and hands it over — whatever the peer writes, or any program defect, may corrupt the data on it.

Do not use it with important data. Continue?

The L2 cache does not match the current target disk / configuration:

{0}

Clear this L2 cache and rebuild it?
· Yes: the old cache is discarded and relearned (disk and configuration unchanged).
· No: abort startup without changing anything (you will be asked again next time; to stop being asked, adjust the configuration or clear/switch the cache directory).

{0}

Verify now?
· Yes: open the verification window and compare block by block (may take minutes). Once clean, startup continues with this L2 cache.
· No: clear this L2 cache and continue starting (its contents are discarded and relearned).

main.log.bitnessWarning32: ⚠ Running the 32-bit (win-x86) build: the L1 cache's unmanaged memory is capped at about 4 GB by the 32-bit address space (regardless of how much RAM you have), so "cannot allocate a new Slab" appears early and throughput drops sharply. Use the 64-bit build — publish RID win-x64; note that win-x86 is 32-bit, do not mix them up.
